purpose: Profile the frozen gravitational-memory amplitude eta against Planck 2018 high-l TTTEEE plus low-l TT and EE by refitting the same six LambdaCDM parameters and A_planck at each fixed eta.
optimizer: same deterministic three-iteration local CLASS spectral linearization plus exact native low-l likelihood evaluation used in v0.56
anti_tuning: The eta grid and frozen physics are declared before v0.58 profile values are read. No KB, tauH0, p, lambda, CLASS patch-chain, likelihood, or nuisance-definition changes are permitted in response to the profile result.
scope_note: This is a deterministic profile-likelihood robustness test, not a Bayesian posterior or MCMC. A full posterior is a subsequent step if the profile is numerically regular.
